scope.en: V3-5 teaching edition of the existing v3.3.0 numerical baseline: 20 views comprise 3 illustrative device models, 1 statistical demonstration, 2 prescribed mechanism benches and 14 circuit/system benches. The 75 printable entries include these 20 plus 55 legacy/background representations; they are not 75 independently calibrated devices. The release audit separately records reruns of the current numerical baseline. This teaching content adds no new physics, PDK, silicon fit or physical-accuracy gain.
scope.zh: V3-5是现有v3.3.0数值基线的教学版本：20个视图含3个示意器件、1个统计演示、2个预设机制测试台及14个电路/系统测试台。75个打印条目包含上述20项与55项旧版/背景表示，并非75种独立校准器件。发布审计另行记录现有数值基线重跑；本教学内容未新增物理机制、PDK、硅实测拟合或物理准确度提高。

print_convention.en: Prints are enlarged egg-size relief concepts, roughly 60×42 mm in plan. Layer thicknesses are exaggerated; plastic connections do not represent electrical connections. Boards show functions, not fabricated layouts.
print_convention.zh: 打印件是放大的鸡蛋大小浮雕概念，平面约60×42 mm；层厚被夸大，塑料连接不代表电连接，展示板表示功能而非制造版图。

mapping_note.en: Only V33_* entries map one-to-one to the current 20 numeric lessons. Related GIFs attached to legacy prints explain an associated topic and are not a newly simulated animation of that legacy structure.
mapping_note.zh: 仅V33_*条目与现有20个数值课程一一对应。旧打印件关联GIF仅解释相关主题，不是针对该旧结构新做的仿真动画。

beginner.en: Find the gate and the island marked ISO. A high-side switch rides with a changing voltage, like a small control booth on a lift.
beginner.zh: 找到栅极及ISO岛；高侧开关随电压一起升降，像电梯上的小控制室。

undergraduate.en: An isolated NLDMOS separates its source/body domain from substrate while a lateral drift region supports drain voltage. Isolation and gate-source bias are different constraints.
undergraduate.zh: 隔离NLDMOS将源/体域与衬底分开，横向漂移区承担漏端电压；隔离与栅源偏置是不同约束。

graduate.en: Check substrate coupling, body bias and floating-domain transients independently. The ISO boundary supplies no DTI dimensions, breakdown data or isolation qualification.
graduate.zh: 分别研究衬底耦合、体偏置和浮动域瞬态；ISO边界不提供DTI尺寸、击穿数据或隔离认证。

structural_limit.en: N-channel high-side well and extended drain; distinguish the floating source/body domain from substrate. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. No foundry cross-section, mask dimensions, dopant profile, local field solution or electrically functional printed device is claimed.
structural_limit.zh: N沟道高侧阱与延长漏区；区分浮动源体域和衬底。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不代表晶圆厂截面、掩模尺寸、掺杂分布、局部场解或可工作的打印电子器件。

beginner.en: Trace the long drift section beside the gate. This switch can provide the lower path for a buck converter’s current.

undergraduate.en: The low-side NLDMOS is referenced near ground; its body-drift PN junction can conduct during dead time. Channel conduction and diode conduction are different states.

graduate.en: Measure R_on, Qoss and recovery in the actual body connection. A lateral drawing cannot predict avalanche SOA or reverse-recovery transport.

undergraduate.en: A PLDMOS uses a P-channel in an N-type body/well with a lateral P drift region; hole transport and source-referenced gate bias distinguish it from NLDMOS.

graduate.en: A drain extension is a structural concept, not an extracted RESURF solution. Need doping, field plates, bias-dependent capacitance and breakdown measurements.

beginner.zh: 沿N—P—N区域找到中间基区，小控制变化可以改变较大的集电流。

undergraduate.en: An NPN has emitter, base and collector terminals. In forward-active operation I_C≈β_F I_B, while all terminal currents still satisfy KCL.
undergraduate.zh: NPN具有发射极、基极和集电极；正向放大区I_C约为β_F I_B，三端仍满足KCL。

graduate.en: The legacy model is forward-active only. Use A03 to study reciprocal injection, but obtain Gummel/output data before claiming saturation, Early effect or transit-time prediction.
graduate.zh: 旧模型仅正向放大；可用A03学习互易注入，但须有Gummel/输出数据才能研究饱和、Early效应或渡越时间预测。

beginner.en: This three-region stack reads P–N–P. Compare its terminal arrows with the NPN example instead of assuming the same current direction.
beginner.zh: 这三层为P—N—P；应与NPN比较端口箭头，不能假定电流方向相同。

undergraduate.zh: PNP相对NPN反转结极性及常规电流方向；发射极、基极和集电极的职责仍不同。

graduate.en: A polarity analogy does not identify a lateral or vertical PNP process. Need gain, substrate injection and charge-storage measurements for the actual structure.

structural_limit.en: P-N-P region ordering is illustrative; the simulation does not establish lateral versus vertical fabrication. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. beginner.en: The diode is already inside the MOS body structure. During a switching pause, this built-in path can carry current.
beginner.zh: 二极管已包含在MOS体结构中；开关暂停时，这条内置通路可承接电流。

undergraduate.en: The N-channel MOS body diode is its body-to-drift PN junction, not an extra transistor. Its forward drop adds dead-time conduction loss.
undergraduate.zh: N沟道MOS体二极管是体区到漂移区的PN结，并非额外晶体管；正向压降产生死区导通损耗。

graduate.en: The legacy static junction has no recovery dynamics. P02 adds a prescribed charge pulse; physical recovery needs minority-carrier or measured switching data.
graduate.zh: 旧静态结没有恢复动态；P02增加预设电荷脉冲，物理恢复仍需少子模型或开关实测。

structural_limit.en: Represent the body-to-drift junction of an N-channel MOS, not a standalone added diode; legacy model has no reverse recovery. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. No foundry cross-section, mask dimensions, dopant profile, local field solution or electrically functional printed device is claimed.
structural_limit.zh: 表示N沟道MOS的体区至漂移区结，并非另外集成的独立二极管；旧模型无反向恢复。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不代表晶圆厂截面、掩模尺寸、掺杂分布、局部场解或可工作的打印电子器件。

beginner.en: Follow the charging direction from the supply toward the bootstrap store. The diode helps keep charge from simply flowing back.
beginner.zh: 沿电源到自举储能元件的方向看充电通路；二极管帮助阻止电荷直接倒流。

undergraduate.en: A bootstrap PN diode charges the floating capacitor and blocks during a high switch-node interval; reverse voltage and recovery matter separately from forward drop.
undergraduate.zh: 自举PN二极管给浮动电容充电，在开关节点升高时截止；反压和恢复须与正向压降分别考虑。

graduate.en: Need reverse leakage, recovery charge, transient reverse voltage and thermal data. The printed depletion region proves neither blocking capability nor isolation.
graduate.zh: 需反向漏电、恢复电荷、瞬态反压及热数据；打印耗尽区不能证明阻断能力或隔离。

structural_limit.en: A conceptual PN blocking junction; the model predicts neither breakdown nor recovery, and does not prove bootstrap isolation. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. No foundry cross-section, mask dimensions, dopant profile, local field solution or electrically functional printed device is claimed.
structural_limit.zh: 概念PN阻断结；模型不预测击穿或恢复，也不证明自举隔离。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不代表晶圆厂截面、掩模尺寸、掺杂分布、局部场解或可工作的打印电子器件。

beginner.en: Compare the metal-to-semiconductor contact with the two semiconductor regions of a PN diode. The contact itself forms the barrier.
beginner.zh: 将金属—半导体接触与PN二极管的两种半导体区比较，势垒在接触处形成。

undergraduate.en: A Schottky barrier uses a metal–semiconductor interface. Low minority-carrier storage does not eliminate capacitive reverse current or leakage.
undergraduate.zh: 肖特基势垒采用金属—半导体界面；少子储存较少不等于没有电容反向电流或漏电。

beginner.en: Trace the vertical path from the top source toward the bottom drain. The drawing uses silicon carbide as a material concept.
beginner.zh: 从顶部源极沿纵向找到底部漏极；图形展示碳化硅材料器件概念。

undergraduate.en: A vertical SiC MOSFET combines a gated channel with a voltage-supporting drift region. Material properties affect transport and field limits, but ratings belong to a characterized device.
undergraduate.zh: 垂直SiC MOSFET将栅控沟道与承压漂移区结合；材料影响输运和电场极限，额定值仍属于经表征的具体器件。

graduate.en: The legacy law is an assumed terminal model, not a SiC interface-trap or polytype solution. Need gate reliability, temperature I–V/C–V and switching data.
graduate.zh: 旧式是端口假设模型，并非SiC界面陷阱或晶型求解；需栅可靠性、温度I–V/C–V及开关数据。

structural_limit.en: Vertical source-to-drain teaching cell with an enlarged gate/body region; SiC polytype, gate architecture and thickness are not determined by this electrical model. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 纵向源漏教学单元，栅体区放大；电模型不能确定SiC晶型、栅结构和厚度。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Find the thin channel beneath the barrier. The gate controls this path; the picture does not identify how a real normally-off gate was manufactured.
beginner.zh: 找出势垒下的薄沟道，栅极控制这条通路；图形未确定真实常关栅如何制造。

undergraduate.en: A GaN HEMT uses a heterostructure channel. Enhancement mode means the channel is normally off at the specified zero-gate bias; dynamic on-resistance can depend on prior stress.
undergraduate.zh: GaN HEMT采用异质结构沟道；增强型表示规定零栅偏下常关，动态导通电阻可依赖先前应力。

graduate.en: An assumed trap state does not reconstruct trap energy or p-GaN/recessed/MIS fabrication. Validate dynamic R_on, gate limits and reverse-conduction behavior independently.
graduate.zh: 假设的陷阱状态不能重建能级或p-GaN/凹槽/MIS工艺；须分别验证动态R_on、栅限值及反向导通。

structural_limit.en: Show source, drain, barrier, channel and gate-control region; enhancement-mode realization is unspecified, so do not identify p-GaN, recessed-gate or cascode fabrication as verified. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 展示源漏、势垒、沟道和栅控区；增强型实现方式未确定，不把p-GaN、凹槽栅或级联结构称为已验证工艺。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Look for alternating P and N pillars. They illustrate how neighbouring regions can help share a high-voltage field.
beginner.zh: 寻找交替的P柱和N柱；它们表示相邻区域共同分布高压电场的思路。

undergraduate.en: A superjunction uses compensating drift-region charges to reshape the field and trade blocking voltage against conduction resistance. Charge balance is a design condition.
undergraduate.zh: 超结通过漂移区电荷补偿重塑电场，权衡阻断电压与导通电阻；电荷平衡是设计条件。

graduate.en: No pillar charge-balance or avalanche solution is implemented. Doping/profile tolerances, nonlinear Coss and body-diode behavior need separate data.
graduate.zh: 未实现柱电荷平衡或雪崩求解；掺杂/轮廓公差、非线性Coss与体二极管特性需另有数据。

structural_limit.en: Alternating P/N drift pillars distinguish this concept from an ordinary MOSFET; no charge-balance, avalanche or manufacturing dimensions are solved. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 交替P/N漂移柱区别于普通MOS；未求解电荷平衡、雪崩或制造尺寸。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Find the P collector underneath the drift region. This extra injecting region makes the device more than a MOSFET with a new label.
beginner.zh: 找到漂移区下的P集电区；该注入区域使它不是简单给MOSFET换标签。

undergraduate.en: An IGBT combines MOS gate control with bipolar injection. Stored minority charge can reduce conduction resistance and produce turn-off tail current.
undergraduate.zh: IGBT结合MOS栅控制与双极注入；少子储存可降低导通电阻，也可产生关断尾电流。

graduate.en: The authored tail constant is not a carrier-lifetime extraction. Need conductivity-modulation, switching and temperature data; IGBT is not a default 40–150 V buck choice.
graduate.zh: 人为尾电流时间常数不是提取的载流子寿命；需电导调制、开关及温度数据，IGBT并非40～150 V降压的默认选型。

structural_limit.en: Include a P-type collector/injector beneath the N drift region; this must not be a relabeled MOSFET drain. Carrier injection and tail current are only simplified behavioral examples. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: N漂移区下应有P型集电极注入层，不能将MOS漏极简单改名；载流子注入及尾流仅为简化行为示例。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Find Schottky windows beside the P shielding islands. The two features have different roles in the same rectifier.
beginner.zh: 找出P屏蔽岛旁的肖特基窗口，两种结构在同一个整流器中各有作用。

undergraduate.en: A junction-barrier Schottky rectifier combines Schottky conduction regions with PN shielding regions. Its reverse behavior depends on depletion around those shields.
undergraduate.zh: 结势垒肖特基整流器结合肖特基导通区与PN屏蔽区，反向行为取决于屏蔽区周围耗尽。

graduate.en: The print shows topology, not a solved shielding field. Reverse leakage, surge behavior and capacitive switching charge need characterized SiC junction data.
graduate.zh: 打印显示拓扑而非已求解屏蔽电场；反向漏电、浪涌及电容开关电荷需SiC结表征数据。

structural_limit.en: Place P shielding islands beside Schottky-contact windows in an N drift region; enlarged geometry does not establish electric-field shielding or breakdown voltage. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: N漂移区中的肖特基接触窗口旁配置P屏蔽岛；放大几何不证明电场屏蔽或击穿电压。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Touch the raised fin and locate the gate around it. The gate can influence a thin channel from more than one side.
beginner.zh: 摸一摸凸起的鳍并找到周围栅极；栅极可从不止一侧控制薄沟道。

undergraduate.en: A FinFET is a multigate transistor. Effective width and electrostatic control depend on fin geometry; a planar W/L law is only a reduced analogy.
undergraduate.zh: FinFET为多栅晶体管，有效宽度与静电控制取决于鳍几何；平面W/L公式只是简化类比。

graduate.en: The stored smooth terminal law is not BSIM-CMG or a quantum confinement solution. Need actual fin dimensions, contact resistance and calibrated multigate data.
graduate.zh: 保存的平滑端口式不是BSIM-CMG或量子限域解；需实际鳍尺寸、接触电阻及多栅校准数据。

structural_limit.en: Gate wraps a raised fin in a generic multi-gate teaching structure; no BSIM-CMG, fin dimensions, substrate isolation or specific node is inferred. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 栅绕凸起鳍部的通用多栅教学结构；不推断BSIM-CMG、鳍尺寸、衬底隔离或具体节点。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Find the thin IGZO layer joining source and drain and the dielectric separating it from the gate.

undergraduate.en: An amorphous-oxide TFT controls conduction in a deposited thin film. Field-effect mobility, threshold and contact resistance describe different contributions.

graduate.en: A square-law reduction omits distributed trap states and bias-stress kinetics. Need sweep-rate, illumination, temperature and contact-length dependence.
graduate.zh: 平方律简化遗漏分布陷阱及偏压应力动力学；需扫描速度、照明、温度及接触长度相关数据。

structural_limit.en: A representative thin-film layer stack, not a specific top-gate/bottom-gate paper device or measured oxide microstructure. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 代表性薄膜层堆叠，不是某论文顶栅/底栅器件或实测氧化物微结构。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Point to the organic channel film. Its material is different from the silicon body in a conventional MOS transistor.
beginner.zh: 指认有机沟道薄膜，它的材料不同于传统MOS的硅体。

undergraduate.en: An organic TFT transports charge through a molecular/polymer film. Contact injection and morphology can be as important as gate electrostatics.
undergraduate.zh: 有机TFT在分子/聚合物膜中输运电荷，接触注入和形貌可能与栅静电控制同样重要。

graduate.en: The illustrative strain coefficient is not a mechanical or hopping-transport model. Measure transfer curves under strain cycles, atmosphere and contact conditions.
graduate.zh: 示意应变系数不是力学或跳跃输运模型；需应变循环、环境和接触条件下的转移曲线。

structural_limit.en: The organic film is a generic channel layer; polymer chemistry, morphology and contact injection are not reconstructed. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 有机膜为通用沟道层；不重建聚合物化学、形貌或接触注入机制。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Locate the very thin MoS2 sheet and its two contacts. A narrow entrance can limit flow even if the middle path is good.
beginner.zh: 找到很薄的MoS2片及两端接触；即使中间通道畅通，狭窄入口也可能限制流量。

undergraduate.en: Contact-limited FET current depends on both channel conductance and source/drain injection resistance. Two-terminal mobility extraction can therefore be misleading.
undergraduate.zh: 接触受限FET电流同时取决于沟道电导与源漏注入电阻，因此二端迁移率提取可能有偏差。

graduate.en: A fixed series resistance does not solve a Schottky barrier or thickness-dependent band structure. Use transfer-length or four-terminal data versus gate bias.
graduate.zh: 固定串联电阻不求解肖特基势垒或厚度相关能带；需栅偏相关传输长度法或四端数据。

structural_limit.en: An enlarged 2D sheet and contact regions teach contact limitation; layer count, contact barrier and microscopic defects remain unspecified. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 放大的二维片及接触区用于解释接触限制；层数、接触势垒及微观缺陷未指定。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Follow the sheet between two contacts. Moving the gate setting away from the middle can increase conduction on either side.
beginner.zh: 沿两接触间的薄片观察；栅设置从中间向两侧移动，都可能增强导电。

undergraduate.en: An ambipolar graphene transfer curve has electron- and hole-dominated branches around a charge-neutrality region; it is not a silicon MOS off-state law.
undergraduate.zh: 石墨烯双极性转移曲线在电中性区域两侧分别以电子或空穴导电，不能照搬硅MOS关断规律。

graduate.en: The conductance minimum and smoothing voltage are assumed. Need residual carrier density, contact doping and bias/temperature data before a transport interpretation.
graduate.zh: 最小电导及平滑电压是假设；输运解释需剩余载流子密度、接触掺杂及偏置/温度数据。

structural_limit.en: Use a sheet, not N/P diffusion blocks implying a silicon junction; the simulation is an ambipolar conductance law, not a band-structure solution. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 采用薄片结构，避免用N/P扩散块暗示硅PN结；仿真为双极性电导律，不是能带求解。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Find the narrow tube between the contacts. The ideal lesson lets carriers cross it without scattering, like a clear short tunnel.
beginner.zh: 找到接触之间的细管；理想课程让载流子无散射通过，像畅通的短隧道。

undergraduate.en: A ballistic CNT model describes transmission between reservoirs using mode occupancy. Conductance depends on allowed channels, not a bulk resistor formula alone.
undergraduate.zh: 弹道CNT模型用模式占据描述两端储库间传输，电导取决于允许通道，不能只用体电阻公式。

graduate.en: The single-subband Landauer example omits scattering, contact-barrier self-consistency and tube diameter distribution. Need length/contact and temperature series.
graduate.zh: 单子带Landauer示例遗漏散射、接触势垒自洽和管径分布；需长度、接触和温度系列数据。

structural_limit.en: Use a magnified tube between contacts; tube count and diameter are illustrative, not a microscopic reconstruction or scattering calculation. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 以接触间放大管状沟道表示；管数和直径为示意，不是微观重建或散射计算。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Find the ferroelectric layer above the channel. Its remembered polarization changes how easily the gate turns the channel on.
beginner.zh: 找到沟道上方铁电层；它记住的极化状态改变栅极打开沟道的难易。

undergraduate.en: A FeFET stores information through polarization-dependent threshold shift. Its memory window is a transfer-curve separation, not an extra terminal.
undergraduate.zh: FeFET通过极化相关阈值偏移存储信息，存储窗口是转移曲线间距，并非新增端口。

graduate.en: The rate-independent relay ensemble has no domain kinetics, retention or fatigue prediction. Pulse-width and read-disturb data are needed for memory reliability.
graduate.zh: 率无关继电单元集合不预测畴动力学、保持或疲劳；存储可靠性需脉宽及读干扰数据。

structural_limit.en: A gate-stack ferroelectric layer teaches polarization-driven threshold shift; arrows are state symbols, not solved domain texture or a specified material stack. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 栅堆中的铁电层表示极化引起阈值移动；箭头为状态符号，不是求解的畴纹理或指定材料堆叠。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Look at the symbolic filament between electrodes. It is like a path that can become easier or harder to pass after a write command.
beginner.zh: 看电极间的示意细丝，像一条经写入命令后可变得更畅通或更难通过的路。

undergraduate.en: RRAM represents nonvolatile resistive switching. In this example a bounded state w sets G=G_off+(G_on−G_off)w and evolves beyond voltage thresholds.
undergraduate.zh: RRAM表示非易失阻变；本例有界状态w决定G=G_off+(G_on−G_off)w，并在电压越阈后演化。

graduate.en: The filament is a symbol, not a predicted microscopic shape. Forming, stochastic switching, compliance and endurance require measured pulse distributions.
graduate.zh: 细丝仅为符号，不是预测的微观形状；成形、随机开关、限流及耐久需实测脉冲分布。

graduate.en: Threshold temperatures are illustrative, with no latent heat, nucleation or spatial melt solution. Use pulse-dependent resistance and transient thermal data.

structural_limit.en: Heater and active volume are conceptual; the lumped thermal model does not produce spatial melting, crystallization domains or a fabricated alloy stack. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.

beginner.en: Find the fixed magnetic layer, barrier and free layer. Their relative directions help decide whether the electrical path is easier or harder.

graduate.en: The deterministic two-state law omits LLG dynamics and thermal switching probability. Need resistance-bias, write-error and retention statistics.

structural_limit.en: Separate fixed magnetic layer, tunnel barrier and free layer; magnetization arrows are state labels, not an LLG field or magnetic-domain calculation. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 区分固定磁层、隧穿层和自由层；磁化箭头是状态标记，不是LLG场或磁畴计算。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Unlike an ordinary charge store, this dielectric can remember a polarization direction. The arrows are state labels, not moving parts.

graduate.en: The threshold ensemble is not Landau–Khalatnikov dynamics or material fitting. Need area/thickness, rate-dependent loops, leakage and fatigue data.

structural_limit.en: Show a ferroelectric dielectric between electrodes; polarization markers do not identify a material or reproduce spatial switching kinetics. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 展示两电极之间的铁电介质；极化标记不指定材料，也不复现空间开关动力学。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Find the active layer between the P and N sides and the light arrow pointing outward. Electrical input can become emitted light.

undergraduate.en: A nitride LED converts injected carriers into photons; EQE is emitted photons per injected electron. Optical power depends on current, wavelength and EQE.
undergraduate.zh: 氮化物LED将注入载流子转为光子，外量子效率为每注入电子对应的出射光子数；光功率取决于电流、波长及EQE。

graduate.en: The port law has an empirical droop term, not quantum-well recombination or optical extraction. Need calibrated optical power, spectra and junction-temperature data.
graduate.zh: 端口式含经验效率下降项，不求解量子阱复合或光提取；需校准光功率、光谱及结温数据。

structural_limit.en: Generic P/active/N layers and light-output direction; quantum-well count, band offsets and extraction optics are not reconstructed. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 通用P/活性/N层与出光方向；不重建量子阱数、能带偏移或出光光学结构。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.zh: 找到传输层中间的量子点发光层；这些点表示发光位置，不是逐个测得的点尺寸。

undergraduate.en: A quantum-dot LED injects electrons and holes through transport layers into an emissive nanocrystal layer. Its stack differs from a simple silicon PN diode.
undergraduate.zh: 量子点LED通过传输层将电子和空穴注入发光纳米晶层，层次不同于简单硅PN二极管。

graduate.en: A fixed wavelength and EQE curve do not model exciton balance, size distributions or degradation. Need spectrum, charge balance and time-dependent efficiency measurements.
graduate.zh: 固定波长及EQE曲线不模拟激子平衡、尺寸分布或退化；需光谱、电荷平衡及效率随时间测量。

structural_limit.en: Use transport layers around a dot-emission layer; do not copy a generic silicon PN junction or claim an actual dot-size distribution. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 发光量子点层两侧设置输运层；不直接复制通用硅PN结，不声称真实粒径分布。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

undergraduate.en: A PIN photodetector uses an intrinsic absorption region; responsivity links photocurrent to incident optical power, I_ph=ℛP_opt.
undergraduate.zh: PIN探测器采用本征吸收区，响应度连接光电流和入射光功率，I_ph=ℛP_opt。

graduate.en: Fixed responsivity, constant capacitance and one time constant omit wavelength response, shot noise and transport. Need spectral responsivity, dark I–V and bandwidth.
graduate.zh: 固定响应度、固定电容及单时间常数遗漏光谱响应、散粒噪声和输运；需光谱响应度、暗态I–V及带宽。

structural_limit.en: Show an intrinsic absorption region between P and N; incoming light is an optical boundary, not a third electrical terminal. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 展示P与N之间的本征吸收区；入射光为光学边界，不是第三个电端。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

graduate.en: This generic law does not reproduce the cited perovskite architecture. Need illumination/temperature I–V, area, spectral response and calibrated incident power.

beginner.zh: 分别指出HOT/COLD与电端；温差能推动电荷经过互连的热电臂。

undergraduate.en: A thermoelectric generator couples Seebeck voltage, Peltier heat, Joule loss and thermal conduction. HOT/COLD are thermal boundaries, not electrical terminals.
undergraduate.zh: 热电发电器耦合Seebeck电压、Peltier热、焦耳损耗和导热；HOT/COLD是热边界，不是电端。

graduate.zh: 恒系数下检查Q_hot−Q_cold=VI；扩展集总稳态模型需温度相关材料数据及接触热阻。

structural_limit.en: Keep electrical P/N terminals on interconnects separate from HOT/COLD thermal boundaries; the two thermal plates must not be mislabeled as the two electrical terminals. beginner.en: Follow each of the two separate coils and locate all four ends. A changing current in one coil can induce voltage in the other without a wire joining them.

beginner.en: Trace the two light paths from split to recombine. Changing one path’s timing can change how bright the combined output becomes.
beginner.zh: 从分光到合光追踪两条光路，改变一路的相位可改变合成输出亮度。

undergraduate.zh: MZI通过干涉把相对光相位转换为强度，电驱端与光输入/输出是不同类型边界。

structural_limit.zh: 两条光臂分束后合束；电气G/RET与光学IN/OUT必须区分。不声称波导模式、载流子或行波电极求解。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.zh: 找到MOS旁的Cgs和Cgd标记，它们表示一处电压改变可能需要另一端的电荷。

undergraduate.en: Miller coupling connects gate and drain dynamics through Cgd. The legacy bench solves two coupled voltages with fixed capacitances and a clamped load.
undergraduate.zh: Miller耦合经Cgd连接栅漏动态；旧测试台以固定电容及钳位负载求解两个耦合电压。

graduate.en: Distinguish this coupled fixed-C system from P01’s prescribed nonlinear-charge stages. Neither represents a full calibrated charge-partition compact model.
graduate.zh: 应区分该固定C耦合系统与P01预设非线性电荷阶段；两者均非完整校准的电荷分配紧凑模型。

structural_limit.en: Reuse a MOS teaching section with Cgs/Cgd relationship markers; capacitors are equivalent elements, not extra visible physical device layers. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 复用MOS剖面并标Cgs/Cgd关系；电容为等效元件，不是额外实体器件层。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: The charge symbols beside the PN junction remind us that switching direction may need time to clear stored charge.
beginner.zh: PN结旁的电荷符号提醒我们：改变方向前，可能要时间清走存储电荷。

undergraduate.en: A prescribed triangular reverse pulse has area Qrr. Its peak and duration are constrained by charge and imposed current slope, not by a carrier transport solution.
undergraduate.zh: 预设三角反向脉冲面积为Qrr，峰值和持续时间由电荷及规定电流斜率约束，并非载流子输运解。

graduate.en: Qrr is an input assumption. Validate with double-pulse data over temperature and di/dt; do not interpret the printed markers as measured carrier density.
graduate.zh: Qrr是输入假设；需不同温度及di/dt双脉冲验证，不能把打印标记当成实测载流子密度。

structural_limit.en: Show a PN junction and symbolic stored-charge markers; the triangular current pulse does not solve carrier density or a physical recovery front. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 展示PN结与存储电荷符号；三角电流脉冲不求解载流子密度或物理恢复前沿。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Find the thermal path from the MOS toward ambient. More current can make heat, and heat can make the resistance grow.
beginner.zh: 找到MOS到环境的热通路，电流增加可发热，升温又可能使电阻增大。

undergraduate.en: Under constant current, I²R(T) couples to a thermal RC. Positive resistance temperature coefficient provides reinforcing electrothermal feedback.
undergraduate.zh: 恒流下I²R(T)与热RC耦合，电阻正温度系数形成增强的电热反馈。

graduate.en: Analyze stability of Cθ dθ/dt=I²R(T)−θ/Rθ, including I²R25αRθ. A single-node solution is not a 3D hotspot or lifetime model.
graduate.zh: 分析Cθ dθ/dt=I²R(T)−θ/Rθ及I²R25αRθ的稳定性；单节点解不是三维热点或寿命模型。

structural_limit.en: MOS plus a lumped thermal path; heat arrows represent an assumed single-node relation, not a three-dimensional temperature field. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: MOS与集总热路径；热箭头表示假设单节点关系，不是三维温度场。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: The time/stress marker shows that a transistor can slowly change after use. It is not an extra layer of visible damage.
beginner.zh: 时间/应力标记表示晶体管使用后可能缓慢变化，并不是一层可见损伤。

undergraduate.en: NBTI can increase the magnitude of PMOS threshold under negative gate bias and temperature stress. The example uses an empirical time/temperature power law.
undergraduate.zh: 负栅偏和温度应力下，NBTI可增大PMOS阈值绝对值；示例采用经验时间/温度幂律。

graduate.en: No recovery, reaction–diffusion or trap kinetics is solved. Stress/recovery timing, duty cycle and process-specific distributions are required for lifetime inference.
graduate.zh: 未求解恢复、反应—扩散或陷阱动力学；寿命推断需应力/恢复时序、占空比及工艺分布。

structural_limit.en: PMOS gate-stack teaching section plus a stress/time marker; do not print invented traps as a calibrated defect distribution. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: PMOS栅堆教学剖面及应力时间标记；不把虚构陷阱当标定缺陷分布。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: Compare the 1/f and WHITE markers. Slow fluctuations and broad-band noise are different contributions, not two surface textures.
beginner.zh: 比较1/f和WHITE标记：缓慢波动和宽带噪声是不同来源，不是两种表面纹理。

undergraduate.en: The MOS current-noise PSD is Kf/f+4kTγgm; integrating over a stated frequency band gives mean-square current noise.
undergraduate.zh: MOS电流噪声谱为Kf/f+4kTγgm，在规定频带积分得到电流噪声均方值。

graduate.en: The PSD is not a generated time waveform or a trap-density extraction. Check one-sided conventions, bias dependence and input/output noise referral.
graduate.zh: 频谱不是生成的时间波形，也不是陷阱密度提取；须检查单边约定、偏置依赖及输入/输出噪声折算。

structural_limit.en: MOS structure plus distinct 1/f and white-noise symbols; random topography or a moving noise waveform would not follow from the stored PSD model. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: MOS结构及独立1/f和白噪声符号；随机形貌或动态噪声波形不能由保存的PSD模型直接推出。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

beginner.en: The two printed transistors look alike, yet their assigned numbers can differ, like two classmates with slightly different heights.
beginner.zh: 两只打印晶体管外形相同，分配的参数却可不同，像两位同学身高略有差别。

undergraduate.en: This Monte Carlo example samples Gaussian threshold and positive lognormal resistance, then solves each bias point. Parameter spread is not simulated random geometry.
undergraduate.zh: 蒙特卡洛例子抽取高斯阈值和正值对数正态电阻，再求各偏置点；参数分散不是随机几何仿真。

graduate.en: Do not transfer A04’s pair-correlation interpretation automatically. Validate the joint parameter distribution and sample uncertainty with process measurements.
graduate.zh: 不能自动套用A04的配对相关解释；需工艺测量验证联合参数分布及抽样不确定度。

structural_limit.en: Identical teaching transistors illustrate parameter samples; differing surface roughness or dopant maps are not generated by this Monte Carlo model. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. It is not foundry geometry, a solved local field, or an electrically functional printed component.
structural_limit.zh: 相同教学晶体管表示参数样本；本Monte Carlo模型不生成不同表面粗糙度或掺杂图。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；不是晶圆厂几何、局部场解或可工作的打印电子元件。

scope.zh: 发布审计已重跑现有20模型基线及回归检查；数值通过不校准该几何，也不验证真实硅行为。

beginner.en: A gate is like a tap handle: a small control change can change the flow. The gate acts through an electric field; it is not a moving door. The picture does not show individual electrons.
beginner.zh: 栅极像水龙头的把手：轻轻调整，就能改变流量。栅极靠电场起作用，并不是会移动的门；图片也没有逐个显示电子。

undergraduate.en: Transconductance is the local sensitivity of drain current to gate voltage at fixed other terminal voltages.
undergraduate.zh: 跨导是其他端口电压固定时，漏电流对栅压的局部变化率。

graduate.en: The revision improves derivatives of the authored equation. Missing DIBL, velocity saturation and intrinsic charge partition can dominate physical error.
graduate.zh: 本次基线改进的是人为方程的导数计算。未包含的DIBL、速度饱和及内禀电荷分配可能主导物理误差。

structural_limit.en: Four electrical terminals require a visible body connection. The drawing represents a generic MOS concept; the interpolation does not determine process geometry or intrinsic charge partition. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 四电端须显示独立体连接。图为通用MOS概念；插值模型不确定工艺几何或内禀电荷分配。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

beginner.en: Imagine a stretchy storage pocket: how much extra charge it can hold changes with its voltage. The pocket is an analogy. This animation scans voltages and does not show a moving physical boundary.
beginner.zh: 想象一个可变大小的储物袋：电压不同，多放一点电荷的能力也不同。储物袋只是比喻。动画扫描不同电压，没有计算真实边界怎样移动。

undergraduate.en: Junction differential capacitance is dQ/dV. Nonlinear stored charge is an integral, not generally C(V)V.
undergraduate.zh: 结的微分电容为dQ/dV；非线性储存电荷应通过积分求得，通常不等于C(V)V。

graduate.en: Rationalization removes cancellation near zero; a stress-test percentage does not describe accuracy of the entire plotted C–V range or measured junction.
graduate.zh: 有理化消除零附近的相消误差；压力测试的改善比例不能代表全部C–V区间或实测结的准确度。

structural_limit.en: A PN junction with a marked depletion region illustrates voltage-dependent capacitance; the depletion-width shape is symbolic, not solved from doping. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: PN结与耗尽区标记表示压变电容；耗尽宽度形状为符号，不是由掺杂求解。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

beginner.en: A small change at a control point can produce a large flow change, like gently opening a sensitive valve. This is a transistor, not a mechanical valve. The plot does not show carriers travelling through the base.
beginner.zh: 像轻轻打开一个灵敏的阀门，控制处的小变化可以带来明显的流量变化。这是晶体管，不是机械阀门；曲线没有显示载流子穿过基区的过程。

undergraduate.en: The Ebers–Moll model combines forward and reverse junction injection and enforces three-terminal current conservation.
undergraduate.zh: Ebers–Moll模型叠加正、反向结注入，并满足三端电流守恒。

graduate.en: An expm1 implementation has floating-point-scale KCL residuals. That does not validate β versus current, Early effect or RF behavior.
graduate.zh: expm1实现的KCL残差处于浮点量级；这不验证电流相关β、Early效应或射频行为。

structural_limit.en: A generic silicon NPN section, not SiGe HBT; its emitter/base/collector regions do not imply a specific vertical process or transit-time simulation. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 通用硅NPN剖面，非SiGe HBT；发射基集电区不隐含特定纵向工艺或渡越时间仿真。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

scope.zh: 发布审计已重跑现有20模型基线及回归检查；数值通过不校准该几何，也不验证真实硅行为。

beginner.en: Two cookies made with the same cutter can still differ a little. Bigger cookies can make tiny edge differences less important. Real mismatch comes from manufacturing variation, not cookie edges. These random numbers are assumed, not factory measurements.
beginner.zh: 同一个模具做的两块饼干仍可能略有不同；饼干变大时，细小差别的相对影响可能减小。真实失配来自制造差异，不是饼干边缘；这里的随机数是假设，并非工厂测量。

undergraduate.en: Pair mismatch is a difference of two device parameters; shared variation can cancel, while local variation remains.
undergraduate.zh: 配对失配是两个器件参数之差；共同变化可相消，局部差异仍存在。

graduate.en: 80,000 samples reduce sampling uncertainty; a particular sample standard deviation can still move farther from the analytic value. No yield gain follows.
graduate.zh: 80000个样本降低抽样不确定度；某次样本标准差仍可能更远离解析值，也不能据此宣称良率提高。

structural_limit.en: Two identical MOS teaching sections indicate matched nominal devices. Differences are statistical parameters; do not print different dopant maps or call the diagram a verified common-centroid layout. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 两个相同MOS剖面表示名义配对器件。差异属于统计参数；不绘制不同掺杂图，也不称其为验证的共质心版图。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

beginner.en: Two slides share one fixed stream of balls: sending more down one leaves fewer for the other. The two transistors steer electrical current. The fixed total comes from an ideal source in this example.
beginner.zh: 两条滑道分同一股小球：一边分得多，另一边就少。两只晶体管分配的是电流；本例的固定总量由理想电流源提供。

undergraduate.en: A MOS differential pair converts differential input voltage into a branch-current difference.
undergraduate.zh: MOS差分对将差分输入电压转换为支路电流之差。

graduate.en: The 80-step solution is already at double-precision resolution. A small KCL residual does not establish bandwidth, CMRR or input offset.
graduate.zh: 80步求解已达到双精度分辨率；很小的KCL残差不等于已验证带宽、共模抑制比或输入失调。

structural_limit.en: Two MOS sections sharing an ideal tail-source node show the circuit relation; load and amplifier compensation must not be invented as simulated components. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 两个MOS剖面共用理想尾源节点表示电路关系；不得虚构已仿真的负载或放大器补偿。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

scope.zh: 发布审计已重跑现有20模型基线及回归检查；数值通过不校准该几何，也不验证真实硅行为。

beginner.en: One ruler reading falls as a room warms while another rises. Adding the right amounts can keep the total steadier. This is a calculated voltage sum, not a real thermometer or a complete working reference chip.
beginner.zh: 房间变暖时，一个读数下降，另一个上升；按合适比例相加，总数就更稳定。这里计算的是电压之和，并不是真实温度计或完整基准芯片。

undergraduate.en: CTAT decreases with absolute temperature; PTAT is proportional to absolute temperature. Their weighted sum cancels first-order drift near a design point.
undergraduate.zh: CTAT随绝对温度下降，PTAT与绝对温度成正比；加权合成可在设计温度附近抵消一阶温漂。

graduate.en: Analytic evaluation has negligible numerical residual; curvature and missing mismatch dominate the interpretation. It is not a reproduction of Brokaw’s measured circuit.
graduate.zh: 解析求值的数值残差很小，但曲率及未建模失配限制结论；它不复现Brokaw的实测电路。

structural_limit.en: Use conceptual junctions and an arithmetic sum, not a purported Brokaw transistor-level circuit or bandgap layout. Labels are conceptual signals because the simulation has no electrical-port list. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 使用概念结及算术合成，不虚称Brokaw晶体管电路或带隙版图。标签为概念信号，仿真无电端口列表。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

scope.zh: 发布审计已重跑现有20模型基线及回归检查；数值通过不校准该几何，也不验证真实硅行为。

beginner.en: A quiet room can still have many small sounds. Adding a wider range of sounds can make the total louder. Sound is only a comparison. The plot shows electrical noise density, not a recording of sound or a random voltage waveform.
beginner.zh: 安静的房间也有细小声音；把更宽范围的声音加起来，总声音可能更大。声音只是类比；图里是电噪声密度，不是录音或随机电压的时间波形。

undergraduate.en: Voltage PSD integrates to variance; amplitude spectral density is its square root. An equilibrated sampled capacitor has thermal variance kT/C.
undergraduate.zh: 电压功率谱密度积分得到方差，幅度谱密度是其平方根；达到热平衡的采样电容热噪声方差为kT/C。

graduate.en: Analytic quadrature improves a metric of the chosen PSD. Unknown current noise, source impedance, aliasing and switching ripple remain physical gaps.
graduate.zh: 解析积分改进选定频谱的指标计算；电流噪声、源阻抗、混叠和开关纹波仍是物理缺项。

structural_limit.en: Print spectral/noise-path symbols and a sampling capacitor. The saved model is not a complete chopper amplifier, transistor noise generator or sampled switching netlist. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.

beginner.en: Before a heavy gate changes position, its helper must move some charge. That takes time even when the command is quick. Nothing mechanically moves. The stages are prescribed, and the current does not include every charging or recovery current.
beginner.zh: 像推动一扇重门前要先用力，开关改变状态前需要移动电荷，即使命令很快也要时间。没有机械门在移动；阶段由模型规定，图中电流未包含所有充电和恢复电流。

undergraduate.en: Miller charge is the gate-drain charge transferred during a drain-voltage transition; finite gate current sets its transition time.
undergraduate.zh: Miller电荷是漏压变化期间转移的栅漏电荷；有限栅电流决定转换时间。

graduate.en: Stagewise quadrature refines the assumed trajectory; this is not a coupled charge-conserving compact MOS model or a SOA prediction.
graduate.zh: 分阶段积分细化假设轨迹；它不是耦合电荷守恒MOS紧凑模型，也不预测SOA。

structural_limit.en: Use a generic HV MOS teaching section plus Cgd/Cgs/Coss relationship symbols. There is no extracted LDMOS cell or complete charge-conserving transistor port model. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 使用通用高压MOS剖面及Cgd/Cgs/Coss关系符号。没有提取的LDMOS单元或完整电荷守恒晶体管端口模型。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

beginner.en: When two gates take turns, a short pause avoids opening both together. During the pause, another path carries the flow. The spare path is a diode. A prescribed triangle illustrates recovery; it does not show actual stored carriers leaving a junction.
beginner.zh: 两道门轮流开时，中间留一点空档，避免同时打开；空档里由另一条路承接流量。承接的是二极管通路；三角形脉冲只是恢复示意，并非逐个计算存储载流子离开结区。

undergraduate.en: Dead time prevents simultaneous switch commands but permits diode conduction. Reverse-recovery charge is the time integral of reverse recovery current.
undergraduate.zh: 死区避免上下管同时收到导通指令，但可产生二极管导通；反向恢复电荷为恢复电流的时间积分。

graduate.en: Closed-form trajectories already have negligible discretization error. Carrier transport, Coss commutation and gate overlap remain uncoupled.
graduate.zh: 闭式轨迹的离散误差已很小；载流子输运、Coss换流及栅交叠仍未耦合。

structural_limit.en: The source bench relates a half bridge and its low-side body diode: diode anode at GND/source and cathode at SW/drain. The printable PN junction illustrates only the diode structure; half-bridge wiring and dead-time relations remain in the companion explanation. Recovery-charge marks are symbolic; the separate pulse is not a solved charge distribution. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 原测试台联系半桥及低侧体二极管：阳极接GND/源，阴极接SW/漏。打印PN结仅表示二极管结构；半桥接线与死区关系在旁册解释。恢复电荷为符号；独立脉冲不是求解的电荷分布。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

beginner.en: A small battery rides in a lift: its height above the floor changes, but the battery still has its own two ends. The bootstrap part is a capacitor, not a battery. Its local voltage is measured relative to the moving switch node.
beginner.zh: 一块小电池坐电梯：它离地面的高度改变，但电池仍有自己的两个端点。自举元件是电容，不是电池；其局部电压相对正在变化的开关节点测量。

undergraduate.en: A bootstrap capacitor powers the floating high-side driver; its differential voltage V_BS=V_B−V_S must retain adequate supply margin.
undergraduate.zh: 自举电容为浮动高侧驱动供电；差分电压V_BS=V_B−V_S须保持足够的供电裕量。

graduate.en: Exact recursion is numerically converged but excludes negative-SW overcharge, startup charging and real leakage/recovery. It cannot certify high-duty operation.
graduate.zh: 精确递推在数值上收敛，但遗漏负SW过充、启动充电和真实漏电/恢复，不能认证高占空比工作。

structural_limit.en: Bootstrap diode and capacitor float above VS. VB and VS are nodes; VBS=VB-VS is a difference, not a third pin or the absolute gate voltage. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 自举二极管与电容浮于VS之上。VB与VS是节点；VBS=VB-VS为差值，不是第三引脚或绝对栅压。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

beginner.en: A quick push on one side of a soft divider can disturb the other side even without a direct opening. Electrical coupling here uses a tiny capacitor, not a moving wall. The picture does not contain a full logic receiver.
beginner.zh: 在柔软隔板一边猛推一下，即使没有开口，另一边也会受扰。这里通过小电容耦合，不是墙在移动；图中没有完整逻辑接收器。

undergraduate.en: Common-mode slew injects displacement current through parasitic capacitance; receiver impedance converts it into a differential disturbance.
undergraduate.zh: 共模电压变化通过寄生电容注入位移电流，接收端阻抗将其变为差模扰动。

graduate.en: An analytic peak only validates this RC reduction. The cited 20 V and 400 V circuits neither calibrate it nor prove any catalogued foundry rating.
graduate.zh: 解析峰值只验证此RC简化；所引20 V和400 V电路既未校准本模型，也不能证明目录中晶圆厂的耐压。

structural_limit.en: A capacitive coupling path into an unclamped RC receiver illustrates susceptibility. Do not draw isolation barriers, logic latches or clamp devices as though they were simulated. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 电容耦合进入未钳位RC接收端表示扰动敏感性。不得将隔离栅、逻辑锁存器或钳位器件画成已经仿真。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

scope.zh: 发布审计已重跑现有20模型基线及回归检查；数值通过不校准该几何，也不验证真实硅行为。

beginner.en: A scale measures a load, and an alarm rings after the reading becomes large enough. Both reading and ringing take time. The alarm only reports a result here; it does not turn off the current. The circuit senses near ground.
beginner.zh: 秤测出重量，读数足够大时警铃响起；读数变化和响铃都需要时间。本例警铃只报告结果，不会切断电流；检测电路工作在接近地电位处。

undergraduate.en: A shunt converts current into voltage; finite amplifier bandwidth and comparator delay determine detection timing.
undergraduate.zh: 分流电阻把电流转为电压，放大器有限带宽和比较器延迟决定检测时刻。

graduate.en: Event placement is refined, while the analytic trip-time metric was already exact. Offset is assumed; noise, blanking and common-mode recovery are absent.
graduate.zh: 改进的是事件定位，解析触发时刻指标原已精确；失调是假设，未含噪声、消隐及共模恢复。

structural_limit.en: A ground-referenced shunt, first-order amplifier and delayed comparator form a functional board. It is not a high-side/HV common-mode current-sense IC cross-section. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 地参考取样电阻、一阶放大器与延迟比较器组成功能板。不是高侧/高压共模电流检测IC剖面。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

scope.zh: 发布审计已重跑现有20模型基线及回归检查；数值通过不校准该几何，也不验证真实硅行为。

beginner.en: A toy waits until its energy cup is full enough to start, and stops only when the level falls to a lower mark. The cup is a capacitor and the marks are voltage thresholds. The model is not a physical high-voltage startup transistor.
beginner.zh: 玩具等“能量杯”装到较高刻度才启动，降到较低刻度才停止。杯子比喻电容，刻度比喻电压阈值；模型并非真实高压启动晶体管。

undergraduate.en: Startup current charges an auxiliary supply; UVLO hysteresis uses distinct enable and disable thresholds to avoid immediate toggling.
undergraduate.zh: 启动电流给辅助供电电容充电，UVLO迟滞采用不同开启和关闭阈值以避免立即反复翻转。

graduate.en: Event-aligned exactness holds only in the checked constant-current domain. No JFET transport, handover circuit, clamp SOA or startup-rating guarantee is modeled.
graduate.zh: 事件对齐的精确性仅限已检查的恒流域；未模拟JFET输运、接管电路、钳位SOA或保证启动范围。

structural_limit.en: Print a behavioral current-source block, auxiliary capacitor and hysteretic logic. Do not relabel the current source as a simulated JFET microscopic device. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 打印行为电流源、辅助电容与迟滞逻辑。不得把电流源改称已仿真的JFET微观器件。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

beginner.en: A swing moves back and forth after a push. Friction gradually turns its stored motion into heat. The circuit stores electric and magnetic energy, not swinging motion. Its starting push is chosen by the model.
beginner.zh: 秋千被推一下后会来回摆动，摩擦逐渐把储存的运动能量变成热。电路储存电场能和磁场能，并非机械摆动；初始“推力”是模型预设的。

undergraduate.en: A series RLC free response transfers energy between capacitor and inductor; resistance dissipates it.
undergraduate.zh: 串联RLC自由响应在电容与电感间交换能量，由电阻耗散。

graduate.en: Quadrature refinement improves the energy audit; the initial peak is imposed, not predicted from a switching edge. No EMI or repetitive snubber power follows.
graduate.zh: 细化积分改进能量核算；初始峰值是给定而非由开关边沿预测，不能据此推算EMI或周期吸收功率。

This is a ringing surrogate, not a literal parallel RC snubber or an extracted switching loop. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 原测试台为串联R-L-C；编号功能块不体现其实际接线拓扑。这是振铃替代模型，不是实际并联RC吸收器或已提取开关回路。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

scope.en: The release audit reran the current 20-model baseline and its regression checks. A numerical pass does not calibrate this geometry or validate silicon behavior.
scope.zh: 发布审计已重跑现有20模型基线及回归检查；数值通过不校准该几何，也不验证真实硅行为。

beginner.en: An energy budget is like tracking where pocket money goes. Energy used as heat is no longer delivered to the load. The bars are steady losses, not moving heat maps. The shared temperature is not the temperature of each transistor junction.
beginner.zh: 能量账本像记录零花钱花到哪里；变成热的能量就不能送给负载。条形表示稳态损耗，不是会流动的热图；共同温度也不是每只晶体管的结温。

undergraduate.en: A loss ledger sums distinct energy mechanisms; a thermal resistance/capacitance converts assumed loss into an effective temperature rise.
undergraduate.zh: 损耗账本对不同能量机制分别求和，热阻/热容把假设损耗换算为等效温升。

graduate.en: Tight residuals certify the ledger calculation only. Full E_on must not be added again to separately counted overlap/Coss/Qrr; no measured efficiency claim is made.
graduate.zh: 小残差只证明账本运算；已分别计入交叠/Coss/Qrr时不可再叠加完整E_on，不宣称实测效率。

structural_limit.en: Print electrical-loss categories feeding one effective thermal node. This is a loss ledger, not a literal chip cross-section; THOT is not an individual MOS junction temperature. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 打印电损耗分类流入一个等效热节点。这是损耗预算，非真实芯片截面；THOT不是单个MOS结温。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。

name.en: Averaged buck soft-start and current-reference limit
name.zh: 平均Buck软启动与电流参考限幅

label.en: Current numerical baseline rerun; educational scope only
label.zh: 现有数值基线已重跑；仅限教学范围

scope.en: The release audit reran the current 20-model baseline and its regression checks. A numerical pass does not calibrate this geometry or validate silicon behavior.
scope.zh: 发布审计已重跑现有20模型基线及回归检查；数值通过不校准该几何，也不验证真实硅行为。

beginner.en: A helper turns the target up slowly at startup. If too many toys ask for power, the helper reaches a limit and the output can fall. This movie shows averages. It does not show each switching pulse or promise a safe limit for every current peak.
beginner.zh: 小助手启动时慢慢提高目标；若太多玩具同时要电，助手达到上限，输出就可能下降。动画显示平均量；没有逐个开关脉冲，也不保证每个电流尖峰都被安全限制。

undergraduate.en: Soft-start ramps the reference; a PI voltage loop requests current through a finite-bandwidth inner loop, with a clipped current reference.
undergraduate.zh: 软启动使参考缓升，PI电压环经有限带宽内环请求电流，且电流参考被限幅。

graduate.en: The reference’s tolerance comparison is empirical, not a rigorous bound. A 10 µs saved trace cannot resolve sub-cycle spikes or subharmonics.
graduate.zh: 参考解的容差比较为经验估计，并非严格界限；10 µs保存间隔无法分辨周期内尖峰或次谐波。

structural_limit.en: Print a functional average-control path and power stage. Duty and current reference are abstract signals; there are no resolved PWM edges or verified cycle-by-cycle peak protection. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
structural_limit.zh: 打印平均控制路径及功率级功能图。占空比与电流参考为抽象信号；没有解析PWM边沿或验证逐周期峰值保护。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。
